description.mekexdeorum.advanced_sieve_f: The second factory tier of the Sieve Machine: 5 input bars plus separate progress arrows, 80000 FE buffer. Upgrade with an Advanced Tier Installer.
description.mekexdeorum.basic_sieve_fact: The first factory tier of the Sieve Machine: 3 input bars plus separate progress arrows, 40000 FE buffer. Use a Basic Tier Installer on a Universal Sieve to build one.
description.mekexdeorum.elite_sieve_fact: The third factory tier of the Sieve Machine: 7 input bars plus separate progress arrows, 160000 FE buffer. Upgrade with an Elite Tier Installer.
description.mekexdeorum.ultimate_sieve_f: The top factory tier of the Sieve Machine: 9 input bars plus separate progress arrows, 320000 FE buffer. Built with an Ultimate Tier Installer; there is nothing above it.
description.mekexdeorum.universal_sieve: A Mekanism powered sieve. Install any Ex Deorum mesh to sift materials automatically; better meshes process more items per operation.
mekexdeorum.configuration.eject.dynamicE: Throttle the eject attempts of an idle machine: after 200 ticks without a successful eject it only tries once every 20 ticks, and a success resets the timer. Off means every tick attempts. The 200/20 numbers are fixed.
mekexdeorum.configuration.enchantment.ef: Fraction of the processing time removed per level of Efficiency. 0.15 means -15% per level. Range 0.0 - 1.0.
mekexdeorum.configuration.enchantment.fo: Relative increase of the rolled result amount per level of Fortune. 0.0 disables it; 0.5 means +50% per level. Range 0.0 - 10.0.
Absolute chance added to every result's drop chance per level of Fortune, capped at a chance of 1.0. Range 0.0 - 1.0.
mekexdeorum.configuration.energy.baseEne: Energy buffer of the Universal Sieve (tier 0), in FE.
mekexdeorum.configuration.energy.energyC: Energy buffer multiplier per factory tier: capacity = base * multiplier^tier. At 2.0 the five tiers get 20000 / 40000 / 80000 / 160000 / 320000 FE. Range 1.0 - 1024.0.
mekexdeorum.configuration.energy.energyP: Energy consumed per input item of one sieving operation, in FE. An operation that consumes n items draws n times this amount.
mekexdeorum.configuration.machine.meshDa: Whether the installed mesh takes durability damage. Only damageable meshes are affected; the six Ex Deorum meshes are not damageable, so this changes nothing for them.
mekexdeorum.configuration.machine.output: Number of output slots of every sieve machine. Oversized slots hold up to 2.1 billion items each; anything that does not fit goes into an internal overflow buffer instead of being lost. Range 1 - 64.
mekexdeorum.configuration.title: MekExDeorum settings
